Perikleous E1

Studio, 14 m², Perikleous 13, Athens

About this suite

A bright 14 m² studio for two, finished in white with gold accents. The bed sits in a built-in alcove with lit niches, open hanging space, a gold-framed mirror and reading lights. A green velvet armchair, a coffee corner with espresso machine and kettle, and a window onto the inner courtyard complete the room. The bathroom has light marble-look tiles and a rain shower.
